fields.label: Function Name
fields.description: The exact name the model uses in its JSON response, e.g. create_sales_order. No spaces.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown to the model so it knows when this function applies, e.g. 'Create a Sales Order'.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Disabled functions are hidden from the model entirely and cannot be run.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: Used to check the calling user has Create permission on it before the script runs.

fields.label: Parameters (JSON)
fields.description: Describes the arguments the model should pass, shown verbatim in the prompt. Example: {"customer": "string (required)", "items": "list of {item_name, qty}", "due_date": "string (optional)"}

fields.label: Script
fields.description: Runs sandboxed via frappe.utils.safe_exec, the same mechanism Server Script uses. The arguments dict is available as `args`. You MUST set a `result` dict before the script ends, e.g. result = {"created": True, "name": doc.name, "doctype": "Sales Order"}. On a soft failure you can instead set result = {"created": False, "error": "..."} or propose a next step: result = {"created": False, "next_action": {"name": "create_customer", "arguments": {...}}, "then": {"name": "create_sales_order", "arguments": args}}. Only System Managers can edit this -- treat it like Server Script.
